subject: gk
question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Justice of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Ali Mohammad Magrey.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Justice Ali Mohammad Magrey:-**

 
 
• He was an Indian Judge and former Chief Justice of the Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court.
 
• He was appointed as a Judge of the High Court on 8 March 2013 and was elevated as Chief Justice on 13 October 2022. He retired on 7 December 2022.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• Justice Ali Mohammad Magrey retired on 7 December 2022.
 
• However when the question was asked he was serving as Chief Justice of J&K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice Prasanna Bhalachandra Varale:-**

 
 
• **He is the current Chief Justice of the Karnataka High Court. **
 
• He was sworn in on October 15, 2022.
 
 
 
• **Justice Pankaj Mithal:-**
 
 
• **He is a Judge of the Supreme Court of India. **
 
• He was appointed on February 4, 2023.
 
• He previously served as the Chief Justice of the Rajasthan High Court, and before that, as the Chief Justice of the Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court.
 
 
 
• Justice Jaishree Thakur:-
 
 
• **She is an Indian Judge and the current Chief Justice of the Madhya Pradesh High Court. **
 
• She was appointed as a Judge of the High Court on 12 February 2014 and was elevated as Chief Justice on 20 July 2023.
